title: Skin Changer
description:
Switch character, card, monster, Ancient, merchant, creature and event skins, with previews in the Other Compendium.

[h1]NO RESTART! SWITCH AND USE INSTANTLY![/h1]

[h2]Details[/h2]
[list]
[*]Switch skins in character select and compendiums, or adjust appearance during a run.
[*]Organize your choices with priorities, presets, skin combinations and bundles.
[*]Browse the curated Workshop catalog and subscribe or unsubscribe in-game.
[*]Customizable themes and 15 interface languages.
[/list]

[h2]Important[/h2]
Supports the v0.107.1 main branch and v0.111.0 public beta.
Skins are subscribed separately. Skin Changer adjusts its load order and prompts for a restart when needed. Multiplayer only shows skins installed on both sides.

[h2]Limitations[/h2]
[list]
[*]Skins with special code, gameplay changes or custom managers may need compatibility work.
[*]Newly subscribed skins may need a restart; check their Workshop labels.
[/list]

[h2]Open Source[/h2]
https://github.com/gurio-wine/STS2-SkinChanger

[h2]Version[/h2]
1.0.17

[h2]Submissions[/h2]
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3787302680/592940620292752301/]Submit a mod on Steam[/url]
[*][url=https://github.com/gurio-wine/STS2-SkinChanger/blob/master/docs/publish-github-skin-mod.md]GitHub mod submission guide[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3787302680/592940620292746467/]Submit a theme preset[/url]
[/list]

This mod was developed with substantial assistance from GPT and DeepSeek. More feature requests and suggestions are welcome!
changeNote: 1.0.17: The GitHub mod submission guide links in the description now point to each language's own guide on the master branch instead of a deleted temporary branch. A third-party mod that ships private libraries next to its own DLL (such as 3D Card Effects' onnxruntime) no longer fails to load them; such dependencies are now resolved from the requesting mod's own package folder and never shadow the assemblies the game ships. / 1.0.17：工坊说明里的 GitHub 投稿教程链接此前指向一个已删除的临时分支，现在改为各语言指向各自语言的 master 分支教程。随包自带私有依赖库的第三方 Mod（例如 3D Card Effects 的 onnxruntime）不再加载失败；这类依赖现在按请求方自己的包目录解析，不会顶替游戏自带的程序集。
